profile.headline: Analytics Engineer | Python • SQL • Cloud | Finance + Media Domains
profile.summary:
I’m an engineer who thrives at the intersection of creativity and technology. 

My journey began as a database manager, where I used Python to automate complex ETL processes and discovered how much I enjoyed solving problems with code. 

That spark led me into backend engineering, where I’ve built reliable, high-performance systems in finance, an environment that demands precision, scalability, and resilience.

Today, I’m expanding my focus into machine learning and data-driven engineering. I work primarily with Python, relational databases, and cloud platforms, and I’m especially excited by applications in music, audio, and user-centered products. 

What motivates me is tackling unique challenges, collaborating across disciplines, and delivering solutions that directly impact people’s experiences.

I bring:

-Strong backend and database engineering fundamentals
-Proficiency in Python for automation and data workflows
-Experience with Java, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD pipelines
-Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud Certified)
-A collaborative mindset, shaped by both technical and non-technical roles

I see my diverse background, not just in engineering, but also in economics and audio, as an asset: it helps me communicate clearly, adapt quickly, and keep the big picture in focus.

If you’re looking for an engineer who combines technical depth with creative problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration, I’d love to connect.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a software engineer in the Commercial Banking division, I contributed to the development and maintenance of enterprise applications supporting invoice processing, payment workflows, and general ledger functions. I worked across the full development lifecycle, ensuring performance, security, and regulatory compliance.

Key Accomplishments:

Built and maintained robust Java/Springboot features for critical financial processes such as amortization scheduling and payment processing.

Developed and optimized REST APIs and serverless microservices to support secure enterprise data exchange.

Improved system reliability by achieving 80%+ test coverage through unit, integration, and regression testing with JUnit and Selenium.

Automated QA testing using Selenium and ALM Octane, reducing manual effort and test cycle times.

Resolved production issues in an on-call rotation, contributing to 99%+ system uptime.

Mentored new engineers and contributed to onboarding and team documentation.

positions.title: Financial Database Manager
positions.description:
Managed the integrity and expansion of a large-scale time series database housing global economic and financial statistics. Focused on automation, data quality, and improving internal processes.

Key Accomplishments:

Maintained and updated 400+ datasets using proprietary ETL tools, ensuring high data accuracy and availability.

Automated ingestion for 80+ datasets using Python, Selenium, and Beautiful Soup, reducing manual workload by 20%.

Decreased data errors by 26% year-over-year by streamlining inconsistent datasets.

Authored 30+ pages of technical documentation to standardize data additions and improve knowledge sharing.

Expanded the database by integrating 34 new datasets covering 2,000+ statistical time series.
positions.insights: Economic Statistics, Time Series Analysis and +8 skills

positions.title: Audio Engineer, Assistant Manager
positions.description:
Oversaw end-to-end audio production for client projects while managing studio operations and supporting high-profile sessions.

Key Accomplishments:

Engineered and mixed audio for 7 broadcast-quality projects using Pro Tools and industry-standard gear.

Coordinated across internal teams and clients from casting through final delivery, improving project flow.

Organized contracts, scripts, and session documentation to streamline studio operations and support tight deadlines.
